text:
maria: Preflight check — kicking off slow-burn geo rollout for release v2.3.0. Plan: US -> APAC -> EU. Hold 20m at each slice, stop/rollback on triggers. tagging @sre-oncall @alex

deploy-bot: Rollout started: release=v2.3.0 commit=sha-abc123 slice=us profile=slow-burn canary=2 probes

alex: Capacity snapshot (just pulled): US GPU pool 72% used baseline (headroom ~18%), APAC 35%, EU warm pool 40%. We have ~120 extra inference slots in us for immediate burst.

jamal: memory ask — any risks with 4096 ctx? last week we saw kv-cache drift ~1.4GB per 1k tokens on that model variant.

sre-oncall: Observability baseline: us-route p95=180ms p99=420ms. Trigger thresholds proposed: p99>500ms OR sustained error rate >1% for 3m OR GPU sat>90% for 5m.

sophia: Recommendation: pin EU fallback to v2.3.0-quant-lite (reduces mem ~30%). Noting quant-lite has slightly different rounding behaviour — watch evals.

liam: Proposed rollback rules: 
- immediate rollback if error rate >1% sustained for 3m
- or p99 latency >2x baseline for 5m
- or GPU saturation >90% for 5m
Agree?

maria: Agree to those. Also add: deploy-bot will auto-pin fallback to v2.2.9 if canary errors >0.5% within first 10m. Adding that to runbook.

deploy-bot: Canary log snippet:
```
[00:02] canary-1 ok
[00:04] warn: retry_count=2 route=us generate latency=120ms
[00:08] canary-2 ok
[00:09] info: probe-resp-time avg=210ms
```

alex: Ran a quick smoke (100 rps for 5m) against canary -> observed 0.2% 500s, avg latency +12ms. Looks acceptable for initial ramp.

jamal: Suggest we run prefix cache warmup before larger ramp: `rictl warm --prefix common-prompts --region us` (takes ~3-4m to seed).

sre-oncall: Also FYI — there's a scheduled EU infra maintenance tonight 23:30-00:30 UTC. If it stays, recommend we delay EU ramp by ~2h and instead do APAC second. ping @maria

maria: Good catch. Plan: US now -> APAC next -> EU last (or postpone EU if maintenance persists). Updating runbook: holdpoints at T+20m per slice. Starting traffic to US at 10% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic update: us=10% apac=0% eu=0% state=running next_holdpoint=T+20m

liam: For release notes: include quant-lite fallback and memory regression mitigations. Also call out rollout pacing and rollback triggers.

sophia: Note: quant-lite alters small token-level probabilities; keep an eye on 'regression-chat' eval set for hallucination/format drift.

maria: If no significant signals at 20m we advance to 30% then 60% then full in ~30m increments. Any trigger -> rollback to v2.2.9 and open incident channel.

jamal: Standing by. I'll post nvml and heap graphs at T+10 (will link).

sre-oncall: Posted graphs: https://cw.example/shortlink (GPU mem trending +3% since canary start, p95 stable). No errors above threshold so far.

maria: Thanks all — keeping this thread for realtime ops. Please call out any anomalies in-thread, ping if we hit holdpoint conditions. :thumbsup:
